evidence.title: HP fined 1.4 billion rupees for “cartelization” of ink cartridges, toner, PCs

summary: India's competition regulator has imposed a ₹1.4 billion fine on HP for anti-competitive practices, including cartelization in the sale of ink cartridges, toner, and personal computers. The penalty follows an investigation into alleged price-fixing and market manipulation.
title: HP Fined ₹1.4 Billion for Cartelization in Ink, Toner, and PC Markets
